title: ZATCA API pull feed response
description: The response shape for pull mode, where we poll your endpoint instead of you calling us. Every key name here is configurable on our side -- these are just the defaults. Tell us your names and we will match them.

status.description: Anything else and we skip the batch and log it rather than importing.

payloads.description: The invoices. An empty array is valid and means nothing new.

meta.description: Optional. Include next_cursor if your feed is paginated.
